headline: Shanghai (Pudong) activity 79% below its 28-day norm
brief_md:
**Shanghai (Pudong)** port calls fell to **18 port calls** on 2026-05-25, **79% below** its 28-day norm of ~86/day (z = -7.1).

_"Congestion" here is inferred from a surge/drop in daily port calls, not from direct vessel dwell-time data._

_Method: STL(7,robust) residual + 28d rolling z. Source: IMF PortWatch — daily granularity, refreshed weekly._
source: IMF PortWatch — daily granularity, refreshed weekly
